items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Dick Gibson. ... Dick Gibson was, is still alive, out in Denver. An impresario. I mean he was a businessman who did very well and he loved Hag and he loved Yank Lawson.

ctx.x: Who named “The World’s Greatest Jazz Band?”
So it wasn’t one of the players.
